prompt:
Subject: citrus slice pattern bikini
and transparent tote bag

Main Subject: A woman in her 20s standing in a vibrant light blue pool up to her thighs, looking back over her shoulder. Position her large in the center of the frame, focusing on the citrus-patterned bikini and the transparent tote bag hanging from her shoulder.

Person/Expression: Rounded oval face with a small chin, large brown eyes, thin arched eyebrows, small nose, and glossy pink lips. Facing the camera over her left shoulder with a soft smile and eye contact. Dark brown hair in a high ponytail with thin bangs and wet wisps near the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose: Triangle bikini with orange, yellow, and green citrus slices on a white background. Clearly define the thin ties at the neck, back, and hips. A white bead necklace and multicolored thin bracelets. Body facing left in the water, only the face looking back.

Background/Light: Fill the entire background with bright turquoise blue pool water, scattering white ripples and light reflections. Strong direct sunlight from above creates white highlights on the hair, cheeks, shoulders, and the edges of the transparent bag, reflecting dancing light on the submerged legs.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Thigh-up portrait from a camera slightly above the water surface. Place the person large in the center-left, with the face in the upper third and the transparent bag in the lower right. Both legs are cut off at the bottom under the water. Sharp focus on the face and bikini, with the water surface also relatively clear.

Texture/Style: A photorealistic live-action photograph taken in a sunny pool. High-definition depiction of wet skin and hair, the citrus pattern on elastic fabric, wrinkles and droplets on the transparent vinyl, and reflections on the water surface.

Negative: Omission of the transparent tote bag; solid color bikini instead of citrus pattern.
